name: Halcyon
description: A temperate world of terraced orchards and quiet harbors, where the evening light turns the sea to copper.

name: Merrow
description: A fog-wrapped moon of salvage yards and rope bridges. Everything here has been mended at least twice.

name: Brigg Station
description: A lantern-lit ring of patched hull plates, humming with pilots trading rumors over bad coffee.

name: Vanterre
description: A world-sized workshop whose night side never goes dark. The factories run on schedules so precise that the trams apologize for being early.

name: Glasshouse
description: A spindle of greenhouses and laboratories where half the Concord's medicines are grown in rows. It smells of mint and disinfectant in equal measure.

name: Pell
description: A dusty commuter moon that houses the people who work on Vanterre. Rents are cheap, and the view of the workshop lights is free.

name: Concordance
description: The seat of the Concord, a planet of white arcades and lantern-lined boulevards. Every treaty in the core was signed here, usually after a very good lunch.

name: Lamplight Yards
description: The Concord's great shipyards, where hulls hang in the dark like lanterns waiting to be lit. The foremen can name every rivet and will, given the chance.

name: Merriwether
description: A gentle garden world that feeds the capital. Its farmers are polite, prosperous and quietly sure they could run the Concord better.

name: Hallow
description: A cloistered world of teaching hospitals and bell towers. Physicians train here for twelve years and leave with excellent handwriting.

name: Tollgate Station
description: A tidy customs post on the road out to the fringe. The officers stamp everything twice, smile once, and keep the coffee hot.

name: Corvana Works
description: A foundry planet under a permanent orange sky. The workers sing in shifts, and the songs are better than the air.

name: Smelt Ring
description: A ring of furnaces turning fringe ore into Concord plate. The crews are paid well, burn often, and treat a good bottle like a holiday.

name: Quillon Spires
description: An old artisans' world of glass towers and narrow galleries. Everything sold here is beautiful, and nothing is cheap except the compliments.

name: Inkwell
description: A dark little moon where the Spires' craftsmen send their apprentices. The workshops are cramped, and the ambition is enormous.

name: Hollis Landing
description: The last proper Concord port before the Reach, all outfitters and survey offices. Prospectors buy their tools here and their courage somewhere else.

name: Picket Station
description: A Concord border picket with more paperwork than guns. The crew watches the Reach through a big window and argues about it at dinner.

name: Brannock Deeps
description: A mining world honeycombed so deep that the miners commute by elevator for an hour each way. They come up hungry and go down bandaged.

name: Shaft Nine
description: An ore depot bolted to a spent asteroid. Shafts one through eight are a long story, and the dockhands will tell it for a drink.

name: Thistledown
description: Rolling red pasture under a wide gold sky, grazed by sheep that look permanently surprised. The farmers mend their own tractors and resent every hour of it.

name: Haywain Station
description: A fuel stop shaped like an old grain silo, which it used to be. The attendant waves at every ship, whether it waves back or not.

name: Wrenhold
description: The Free Reach's heart, a stubborn city of timber halls and loud public meetings. Every citizen gets a vote, a speech, and at least one heckler.

name: The Commons
description: A cooperative station where every dock, bunk and bolt belongs to someone in particular. Pilots who mind their manners are made welcome; the rest are made to sweep.

name: Little Wren
description: A small moon of allotments and fish ponds that keeps the capital fed. Nobody has got around to building a fuel depot, and nobody seems to mind.

name: Kiln
description: A volcanic world where the Reach smelts its own ore and owes nobody for it. The forges never cool, and neither does the conversation.

name: Slag Tender
description: A furnace barge that eats whatever it is fed and asks no questions. Its crew are paid by the ton and have long since stopped looking in the bins.

name: Oxbow Meadows
description: A river-bend world of floodplain farms and long, unhurried barges. The harvest festivals last a week, and the hangovers last two.

name: Ferryman's Rest
description: A boarding house in orbit, run by a retired pilot who remembers everyone's name. Travelers waiting for a ride play cards in the lounge and lose politely.

name: Redwater Sound
description: A world of rust-red seas whose kelp makes the Reach's best fever remedies. The harbor folk taste every batch and will tell you about it.

name: Redwater Locks
description: A chain of pressure docks where the Reach builds its pumps and valves. Everything leaks a little, and everyone is proud that it does not leak more.

name: Brinefield
description: A flat, shining world of salt pans and shrimp farms. The locals are cheerful, sunburned and permanently short of boots.

name: Heron Station
description: A spindly survey post on long legs of scaffold. Its keeper posts odd jobs on a corkboard and pays in cash, mostly on time.

name: Dunmore Crossing
description: A sprawling free port where Concord goods arrive without Concord tariffs. Nobody asks where the crates came from, and the crates never say.

name: Waymark
description: A signal buoy with a fuel line and a single bunk. Pilots carve their names into the bulkhead, and the bulkhead is nearly full.

name: Tallow Rock
description: A pale, wind-scoured rock where hardy settlers render lichen into candle wax and call it a living.

name: Vesk Outpost
description: A lonely relay at the edge of the charts. The porch light is always on, and the pilot on duty is always glad to see you.

name: Mirren Hollow
description: A boggy world of stilt houses and herb gardens, where the healers are better than the roofs. Bring your own fuel; they burn peat.

name: Lastlight Beacon
description: A lighthouse at the bottom of the charts, kept by a family who have never once let it go out. Their fuel is dear, and their soup is free.

name: Brackwater
description: A drowned world of tin-roofed rafts lashed into floating towns. The scrap-divers bring up hull metal by the ton and spend it on anything that reminds them of land.

name: The Midden
description: A wrecked freighter that the whole fringe uses as a rubbish tip. Somebody lives aboard, but they only come out to count the bags.

name: Skerry Light
description: A cold, bright station at the very rim, where the heaters run all year and never quite win. Its keepers trade for anything warm, edible or both.

name: Gull Rock
description: A bare stack of black stone with one abandoned hut on top. The hut's door is unlocked, and someone keeps leaving the kettle full.
